extracted.intended_audience: users of the eCFR (legal researchers, agency staff, and members of the public seeking CFR content)
extracted.subtask_description: Overview and user guidance for Title 1 of the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR), including the legal status of the eCFR, navigation/search instructions, feedback/contact procedures, and pointers to the official published CFR and drafting tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal status of the eCFR
rubrics_metrics.description: The eCFR is a continuously updated online version of the CFR. It is not an official legal edition of the CFR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: View the most recent official publication (Title 1) on govinfo.gov; the official published CFR is updated annually and 'may not include the most recent changes applied to the CFR.' Learn more about the eCFR, its status, and the editorial process via the provided links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office of the Federal Register role and limitation
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of the Federal Register publishes documents on behalf of Federal agencies but does not have any authority over their programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For questions about agency content or programs, 'we recommend you directly contact the agency associated with the content in question.' The OFR is a publisher, not a decisionmaker for agency programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to provide feedback or comments about content
rubrics_metrics.description: If you would like to comment on the current content, please use the 'Content Feedback' button below for instructions on contacting the issuing agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For issues or suggestions about the www.ecfr.gov website itself, use the 'Website Feedback' button. Distinguish between feedback about the website (use Website Feedback) and substantive content/agency material (use Content Feedback to contact the issuing agency).

rubrics_metrics.name: Navigation and search behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Choosing an item from citations and headings will bring you directly to the content. Choosing an item from full text search results will bring you to those results. Pressing enter in the search box will also bring you to search results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can navigate by entering citations or phrases (examples: '1 CFR 1.1', '49 CFR 172.101'). Background and more details are available in the 'Search & Navigation' guide linked on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of the drafting site for amendatory language
rubrics_metrics.description: A drafting site is available for use when drafting amendatory language ('drafting site is available for use when drafting amendatory language').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users drafting amendatory language are instructed to 'switch to drafting site' where drafting-specific tools and context are available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced content purpose and components
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhanced content is provided to the user to provide additional context (e.g., 'Enhanced Content :: FR Reference', 'Enhanced Content :: Timeline', 'Developer Tools').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enhanced content sections include features such as FR Reference, Timeline, Developer Tools, Published Edition links, and other contextual information to assist understanding and use of the eCFR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relationship between eCFR and official published CFR (govinfo.gov)
rubrics_metrics.description: Links to 'View Title 1 on govinfo.gov' go to the official, published CFR, which is updated annually and therefore 'may not include the most recent changes applied to the CFR.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use govinfo.gov links when an official, published edition is required; use the eCFR for a continuously updated online view but note its non-official status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title 1 organizational structure (table of contents)
rubrics_metrics.description: Title 1: General Provisions is organized into chapters, subchapters, and parts with indicated section ranges (e.g., 'Chapter I Administrative Committee of the Federal Register 1 – 49', 'Chapter II Office of the Federal Register 50 – 299', etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page lists parts and reserved ranges and provides direct navigation to parts (e.g., Part 51 Incorporation by Reference 51.1 – 51.11). Use these links to navigate to the specific parts/subchapters of Title 1.
